Learn more Comments 2 In this video Description Blue Angels Return to Cocoa Beach: What to Expect at the Air Show This Weekend 17Likes1,247ViewsApr 102026 The Cocoa Beach Air Show is back this weekend, bringing high-speed aerial performances to Florida’s Space Coast. Organizers say fans can expect a mix of military and civilian pilots, including the U.S. Navy Blue Angels and the Air Force F-16 Viper demo team. Showtime starts at noon Saturday and Sunday, with the Blue Angels scheduled to fly at 3 p.m. both days. Arrive early for parking and a good spot on the beach.
